  • Apoiar tecnicamente as operações, incluindo operações voltadas às finanças verdes e o acesso do setor produtivo às atividades de financiamento de CMF, com orçamento, planejamento das atividades, análises técnicas e preparação de relatórios de progresso.

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a vertically integrated digital agency pioneering the next generation of consumer-facing brands. A category leader in results-driven growth marketing, Darkroom’s success is attributed to our unique partnership model, purposefully built to launch brands to market and accelerate growth across direct-to-consumer. Our model is predicated on three major partnership structures - Growth & Scaling, Digital Platforms, and Brand & Product Launches – threaded by one cohesive, interdisciplinary team.

Taking the startup mindset to the agency space, the collective expertise of our team of entrepreneurs and senior digital marketers are deeply aware of the newest trends in e-commerce, development, and digital marketing. Our learned experience has allowed us to take clients (and internal ventures) from $0 to millions in revenue in just a few months. We work with game-changing brands: Crate & Barrel, Popchips, FEED, Olipop, & CALPAK, to name a few.

Note: This role will be opening again in the next two quarters, and we’d love to hear if you’d be interested in joining our talent pool.

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for acquisition marketing on Meta. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You’re likely a Designer or Creative Strategist by trade but hyper-focused on paid media.

You’ll work on our Dark Arts service, that has been newly relaunched as the AI-powered creative direction service for paid media clients. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content.

Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks. You’ll collaborate closely with performance marketers, designers, and video editors in a fast-paced, remote environment.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of 2-4 designers focused on paid ad creative, with room to grow the team over time.
  • Provide creative direction, actionable feedback, and career support through regular 1:1s and project reviews.
  • Oversee creative quality, ensuring assets align with brand identity, platform best practices, and campaign objectives.
  • Partner with performance marketers and strategists to develop and iterate on high-performing ad campaigns.
  • Help refine internal processes, establish creative standards, and lead collaborative sessions to drive creative innovation.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead concept development and execution for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and display platforms.
  • Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts.
  • Design and direct a range of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content.
  • Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.
  • Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you

  • 3+ years of senior-level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience designing ad creatives for paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, or similar platforms.
  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance-focused ad creative - including static ads, motion graphics, and short-form video - with a strong understanding of visual hierarchy, composition, and platform-specific best practices.
  • Knowledge of how to incorporate AI software into workflows to increase efficiencies and output, including ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, and more.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability to performance results.
  • Skilled at working with performance marketers and creative strategists to write briefs, incorporate feedback, and iterate based on ad performance data.
  • Comfortable communicating in English with internal teams and clients, including presenting creative work and responding to feedback clearly and professionally.
  • Confident giving constructive feedback to other designers and supporting their growth through clear direction and mentorship.
  • Able to take ambiguous campaign goals and turn them into creative concepts that are visually engaging and conversion-focused.
  • Proficient in Figma for ad design workflows; knowledge of Auto Layout, Components, and asset handoff is essential.
  • Experience using Adobe Creative Suite (especially Photoshop and Illustrator) for asset creation and layout design.
  • Bonus: Experience designing high-performing ads for e-commerce brands, familiarity with motion design tools (After Effects, Premiere), or working with UGC creators and editors.

What its like to work at Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

  • Darkweek, Unlimited Vacation Policy, and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy, our annual “Darkweek” summer break, and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Darkroom offers a Phantom Equity Incentive Plan—a long-term, seniority-based cash bonus that vests over five years and pays out if the company is sold, rewarding those who help us grow.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: After one year with Darkroom, we deliver a robust 401k program with company match, equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Familiarity with CRM systems
  • Excellent phone and email communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with customers and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills and keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive problem-solver with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills to assess patterns and propose actionable solutions.
  • High level of adaptability and willingness to take on diverse responsibilities.

  • A Mission You Can Be Proud of: Be part of a brand that stands for quality, innovation, and inspiring education. Be part of a company that’s changing the face of online education, connecting students with top-tier executives.

description:
// Sobre nós

A Faculdade XP:

Somos movidos pelo desafio de melhorar a vida das pessoas por meio da educação. Estamos transformando a educação brasileira assim como a XP transformou o mercado financeiro. Acreditamos numa educação disruptiva, centrada no saber fazer e muita, mas muita mão na massa! Por isso, como marca empregadora referência no Brasil, decidimos abrir todo o nosso know-how em tecnologia e negócios e oferecer como educação para que você inicie, transforme e acelere a sua carreira.

Alavancamos o lifelong learning de pessoas que querem trilhar carreiras em tecnologias e negócios, por meio de um modelo de ensino inovador – não-linear, student centric e de qualidade – aliado a processos e serviços de carreira, conectando os nossos alunos ao que há de melhor no mercado de trabalho brasileiro.

Para aqueles que buscam entender o mundo da tecnologia e dos negócios para crescer de forma exponencial: somos a Faculdade XP!

// Sobre a oportunidade

Como Analista de CRM , você será responsável por garantir a execução eficaz das campanhas de CRM com foco em prospecção, atuando na criação de segmentações, configuração de réguas de relacionamento e disparos de e-mail e WhatsApp para leads da XP Educação. Essa função é fundamental para assegurar que as mensagens certas cheguem às pessoas certas, no momento certo, com clareza, coerência e foco em conversão. Buscamos alguém organizado, com atenção aos detalhes, boa comunicação e capacidade analítica para medir e otimizar os resultados das ações.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Executar disparos de e-mails, fluxos e mensagens via WhatsApp para leads e prospects, utilizando ActiveCampaign;
  • Criar segmentações a partir de filtros comportamentais e dados cadastrais, respeitando o funil de vendas e a régua de relacionamento de cada produto;
  • Atualizar e manter réguas de comunicação automatizadas, garantindo lógica, cadência e conteúdo adequados;
  • Monitorar métricas de engajamento (open rate, clique, resposta, conversão) e gerar relatórios com sugestões de melhoria;
  • Garantir a padronização de mensagens, links de rastreamento (UTMs) e responsividade dos templates;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial para alinhamento entre campanhas, réguas e ações pontuais de conversão;
  • Participar da construção de campanhas promocionais, multicanais e testes A/B;
  • Manter a base de dados limpa, organizada e segmentada corretamente para otimizar o desempenho das comunicações.

Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

  • Nossa cultura de mente aberta torna o ambiente horizontal para que as decisões sejam tomadas com base em fatos e dados, colocando os interesses dos clientes sempre em primeiro lugar.
  • Com espírito empreendedor,cada um de nós protagoniza a sua própria história , então não espere encontrar uma empresa que tome decisões por você.
  • Apesar de todos terem autonomia para assumir as rédeas da própria vida, anossa rotina é intensapor sonharmos grande e amarmos o que fazemos.

// O que buscamos

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Ensino superior completo em áreas como Marketing, Publicidade, Comunicação, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com plataformas de CRM, ActiveCampaign ou similar.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e boa comunicação escrita.
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade na execução de ações recorrentes e campanhas pontuais.
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar métricas de CRM e campanha (open rate, CTR, conversão, churn etc.) e gerar insights para otimização.

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em empresas de educação, tecnologia ou serviços financeiros.
  • Vivência com funil de vendas e jornada de lead em negócios B2C ou educação.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de envio em massa ou automação (RD Station, Mailchimp, etc.).
  • Noções de UX Writing, copywriting ou marketing direto.
    Diferenciais:
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de WhatsApp e e-mail voltadas à conversão;
  • Experiência com testes A/B e rotinas de experimentação em CRM;
  • Inglês básico a intermediário (leitura e escuta).

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with Javascript / Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.

  • Solid knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes security fundamentals.
  • Understanding of cloud security (preferably AWS), including IAM principles, cloud-native service configurations, and network segmentation.
  • Comfortable with Agile development methodologies and working within cross-functional squads.
  • Software supply chain security (e.g., SBOM, artifact signing).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT, CPTE, or CSSLP.
  • AWS, GCP, or Azure Security Specialty certification.
  • Familiarity with bug bounty triage and vulnerability management platforms (e.g., DefectDojo).
  • Experience implementing RASP or eBPF runtime protection tools.
  • Exposure to LLM/AI security considerations and secure code generation practices.
  • Familiarity with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana).

title: Clinical Specialist, CAS (VA & DC)
description:
Overview

We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on 26 Sep 2025.

At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.

A Day in the Life

At Medtronic, your work has a direct and lasting impact on patients, families, and the future of medicine. As a Clinical Specialist in Cardiac Ablation Solutions , you're not just supporting procedures—you’re enabling groundbreaking therapies that can help patients reclaim their lives from complex arrhythmias.

This role includes a pathway to become a Mapping Specialist through a structured training program. Experienced clinical professionals joining as Clinical Specialists will gain deep expertise in mapping systems and complex ablation procedures, positioning them as advanced clinical leaders in the field. This is an ideal opportunity to expand your clinical impact and grow within Medtronic\'s Cardiac Ablation Solutions team.

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. This is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site; the candidate hired will reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver\'s license is essential for this role.

This position posting is location flexible and can be based in any of the following locations (DC or VA).

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide technical, educational, clinical and sales support to assist the Region in meeting Cardiac Ablation Solutions sales and customer service objectives.
  • Represent Medtronic CAS during ablation procedures to provide troubleshooting and other technical assistance.
  • Receive technical inquiries from customers. Research solutions to questions or problems (e.g., Catheter, Console, Generator support).
  • Educate and train physicians, hospital personnel and office staff on technical matters relating to AFS products and related procedures.
  • Assist RM and field training department in educating/training new Clinical Specialists and Account Managers.
  • Provide training and resources for hospital staff to enable them to conduct training for their personnel.
  • Provide sales support to help influence revenue growth within the region.
  • Update sales representatives concerning procedures. Immediately notify Account Manager regarding issues or problems requiring follow-up.
  • Serve as an effective Medtronic CAS representative to physicians and support staff regarding Medtronic CAS products, service and support.
  • Promote the safe and effective use of Medtronic CAS products and related procedures.
  • Understand national, regional and territory sales objectives. Work in partnership with Account Manager to achieve and exceed goals.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work, but they are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and skills for this position.

Must Have Minimum Requirements

To be considered for this role, please ensure these minimum requirements are evident on your resume.

  • High School diploma PLUS a minimum 6 years of work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.
  • OR Associate degree PLUS a minimum of 4 years of work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.
  • OR Bachelor degree PLUS a minimum 2 years work experience in healthcare within an EP, Cath Lab setting or sales in cardiac field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preference will be given to local qualified candidates and candidates with Medtronic experience.
  • B.A./B.S. Degree in nursing, cardiovascular, life sciences, or technical discipline with minimum of four years\' work experience in cardiac field, hospital/clinic or sales.
  • Pacing school/ATI-like training program in addition to BQs.
  • Proven track record with technical training assignments.
  • Experience in the cardiac catheter ablation field, EP lab, in a hospital/clinic or EP medical sales providing technical/clinical support.

Additional Job Requirements

  • Environmental exposure to infectious disease and radiation.
  • Clinical Specialists are required to be within their assigned territory each day to be available for unscheduled needs.
  • Clinical Specialists will on occasion be required to travel outside of their assigned territory and may require overnight travel.
  • Must have a valid driver\'s license.
  • Ability to move around the facility, use a phone, keyboard and mouse, and interact with personal computers.
  • Must be able to stand/sit/walk for 8 hours a day.
  • Must be able to drive approximately 75% of the time within assigned territory and may require overnight travel.
  • Driver\'s license and active vehicle insurance policy; driving record will be reviewed as part of the application.

CARDIOVASCULAR PORTFOLIO:
Cardiac Ablation Solutions offers cardiac mapping and ablation solutions to treat patients with abnormal heart rhythms. Our vision is to help patients worldwide by advancing innovation for the diagnosis and ablation of cardiac arrhythmias, enabling clinicians to perform procedures with superior outcomes.

Physical Job Requirements

The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met to perform the essential functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. For Office Roles: the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile, interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package. Salary ranges for U.S. locations (excl. PR) are $90,000.00 - $100,000.00. The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and certain California locations. The offered rate complies with regulations and may vary based on experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurance, HSA/HC Spending Accounts, life insurance, disability leave, dependent care spending, tuition assistance, and well-being programs.

The following benefits are available to regular employees who work 20+ hours per week: Incentive plans, 401(k) with employer contribution and match, Short-term disability, Paid time off, Paid holidays, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Employee Assistance Program, and other retirement-related plans. Some benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

Further details are available at the link below: Medtronic benefits and compensation plans.

We lead global healthcare technology and boldly attack the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions. title: 10X FullStack Engineer
description:
10x Engineer

SFR3 is a boutique real estate investment fund managing $2B+ of affordable single-family homes. The Fund renovates distressed homes, using software-driven operations to run many “tertiary” markets concurrently. Today we own 10,500+ homes in 20 states.

You

You love building software that directly enables your team to crack critical business challenges. You’ve shipped production applications and can strike the right balance between shipping fast for immediate impact and long-term vision. You enjoy working remotely along with the independence and responsibility that comes with that.

Real estate is the world’s largest asset class, but experience in the domain is not required. What is necessary is motivation to dive in and understand the work people do every day so you can build the right tools that give them leverage. The idea of building & running a $150M/yr business that operates like a startup, growing at 5-7%/yr (not a startup looking for PMF) is exciting to you.

What You’ll Do

Buying, renovating, and managing a portfolio of thousands of homes worth billions of dollars is a big task. Our team is continuously experimenting to improve efficiency and accelerate operations.

You’ll join a pod that consists of seasoned business owners paired with product and have complete ownership over a domain to to crank out needle moving features weekly. There’s a lot for a small team to do, so we look for “T-shaped” engineers. You should be comfortable and confident across any stack, but also have deep expertise in one or more areas where you can be the team expert.

To manage single-family rentals at our scale, we write lots of software that runs our operations. For this dev pod, our users are hundreds of employees and vendors located in 40+ markets who renovate homes, repair issues for residents, and prepare our vacant homes for the next move-in.

In this role, you will:

  • Leverage cutting-edge AI to accelerate development. You’ll experiment with and adopt modern AI tools—like large language models, code-generation platforms, and automation frameworks—to rapidly prototype features, streamline workflows, and continuously innovate. This culture of experimentation and speed ensures we stay ahead of the curve and deliver high-impact products faster.
  • Design and develop backend systems that power our field and property management operations. You'll build robust and scalable services that integrate with both our in house developed solution and external SaaS whether it be a reliable ledger or AI driven resource optimization models.
  • Integrate with third-party APIs (REST, GraphQL, etc.) to enhance our platforms and ensure seamless communication between different services.
  • Collaborate on scoping and prioritizing the roadmap. We constantly ship and evaluate new problems and opportunities to improve workflows. You’ll regularly interact with users, ship fast, and help define our long-term tech vision—making trade-offs between effort and impact to focus on the most critical work.
  • Analyze system efficiency and performance. We’re committed to continuous improvement and optimization. You’ll use data to monitor software performance and identify opportunities that drive business results and enhance system reliability.

Your Stats

You'll be working across multiple backend projects. You might be a great fit if these attributes describe you:

  • Experience building backend systems that drive real-world processes and results.
  • Strong expertise in Python; React, Java and Ruby on Rails knowledge is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming.
  • Deep knowledge of AWS and cloud-based services.
  • Understanding the benefits and tradeoffs of different databases and their setups including PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and DynamoDB.
  • Strong product sensibilities to build experiences users love.
  • AI-first sensibilities.
  • Entrepreneurial experience preferred.

Working timezone overlaps at least 5 working hours with US Pacific Time.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Llm / Ai-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note

Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid, disconnected software modules, our assistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural, empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience for every patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely and reliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empathetic experience that patients and providers trust.

As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfully incorporated into our platform.

This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at the frontier of AI-enabled software development.

We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronous communication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.

Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack TypeScript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture is service oriented and managed in a Monorepo.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant services and applications.
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention to safety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
  • Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for other engineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
  • Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring, automated testing, CI / CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for our products, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards and architectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled product experiences that meet real client needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications, databases, and developer tools.
  • Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
  • Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining production applications at scale.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript / TypeScript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), and PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies (HTTP2, WebSockets, gRPC, GraphQL).
  • Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significant impact.
  • Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it through automated testing, CI / CD, and observability.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g., measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
  • Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
  • Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, Salesforce Communities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
  • Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR / EMR integration.
  • Experience debugging distributed systems.
  • You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and we provide mentorship and guidance as needed.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health / Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

  • Segurança de aplicações (OAuth2, JWT, OWASP).
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, microsserviços e integrações com serviços externos.
  • Atuar na análise de requisitos, modelagem de sistemas e definição de arquitetura.

title: Agile Coach
description:
Overview

Job type: Full-time employee

Ser MJVer é estar em um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar.

Nós sabemos que na construção de uma sociedade mais forte a evolução deve vir de dentro para fora . Por isso, um ambiente acolhedor e com o sentimento constante de pertencimento é fundamental para o crescimento individual e coletivo.

O esforço é de todos nós, e as conquistas também. Porque ser um MJVer é bem mais do que ser um colaborador: é sobre fazer parte.

Somos colaborativos, ágeis, plurais, criativos e inovadores. Somos MJV!

Responsibilities

  • Orienta e mentora os times no entendimento e construção da agilidade, proporcionando escala dos princípios e valores do ponto de vista de cultura ágil, além de direcionar para os métodos e práticas ágeis com aderência aos padrões definidos na organização
  • Trabalha com múltiplos times e vilas para identificar gargalos sistêmicos e evoluir a maturidade ágil, desenvolvendo planos para por exemplo melhorar processos e aumentar produtividade dos times e Vilas
  • Instrumentaliza times com criação e manutenção de ferramentas ágeis e refinamento de melhores práticas
  • Oferece coach avançado (para Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Product Managers, gestores)
  • Trabalha com alta liderança, times de negócio e outros stakeholders (incluindo áreas fora do desenvolvimento de produtos/sistemas) para demonstrar o valor e garantir engajamento com a agilidade
  • Identifica e trabalha para retirar obstáculos que extrapolam a alçada das células (incluindo obstáculos culturais) para escalar uso do ágil
  • Auxilia na criação, acompanhamento e compartilhamento de métricas de eficiência relacionadas a práticas ágeis
  • Gere o funcionamento da governança ágil na vila, suporta PM na facilitação da definição de OKRs de vila e garante a ocorrência das cerimônias
  • Realiza coaching de Scrum Masters e demais papeis do modelo habilitando sua evolução e desenvolvimento de novas capacidades conforme estratégia do ETA
  • Suporta empresas na revisão da topologia, estruturação de vilas, value streams e células
  • Prepara os times das células ágeis, promovendo a agilidade nos negócios, através da polinização de conhecimento, cultura, mindset e modelos de trabalho ágeis, acompanhando seu desenvolvimento desde o nascimento até sua evolução e consolidação como gerador de resultados

Certificações e conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Características fundamentais
  • ·Agente de mudança: Foco em construir e incorporar mudanças à organização; desenvolver caminhos formais para mudança, desenho organizacional;

About the Role

This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.

At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital

assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. title: Broadcast systems engineer - brazil
description: Amagi is a market leader in cloud-based media technology services for channel creation, distribution, and ad monetization. Amagi's cloud technology and managed services are used by TV networks, content owners, and CTV / OTT platforms to create 24x7 linear channels for OTT and broadcast distribution. Amagi delivers unified cloud solutions for channel creation, distribution, and advertisement via its lineup of versatile products, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM.  Amagi's pioneering and market-leading cloud platform has won numerous accolades and is deployed in over 40 countries by 600+ TV networks. Customers of Amagi include A+E Networks, Comcast, Cox Media Group, Google, NBC Universal, Roku, Samsung, Warner Media, and many more.  This role provides a unique and transformative opportunity to grow a world-class technology organization by innovating how content is originated, distributed, and monetized. Amagi has offices in New York, Los Angeles, London, New Delhi, and Bangalore.  About The Role  As a Sr. Systems Engineer at Amagi, you will serve as a trusted advisor to our broadcast customers, leveraging your deep expertise in broadcast engineering and streaming technologies to address customer challenges and drive adoption of Amagi's cloud-based media technology solutions. You will be responsible for the technical aspects of the pre-sales process, ensuring seamless integration and alignment of our products with customer needs, while representing Amagi's innovative broadcast solutions in the market.  Key Responsibilities  Technical Leadership: Act as the primary technical resource for the sales team, providing expert guidance on broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, distribution, and streaming technologies  Solution Design & POCs: Collaborate with clients to understand their broadcast and streaming needs, design tailored solutions, and create customer-focused Proofs of Concept (POCs) with clearly defined success criteria  Pre-Sales Support: Lead technical discussions during the pre-sales process, including gathering customer requirements, conducting technical demos, and responding to Requests for Proposals (RFPs). Manage technical customer engagement and ensure a smooth handoff to the onboarding team  Product Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of Amagi's products and services, including Amagi CLOUDPORT and Amagi THUNDERSTORM, to build and deliver curated demos, technical presentations, and training materials  Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a technical advisor and ensuring their long-term success with Amagi's broadcast solutions  Industry Engagement: Represent Amagi at trade shows, conferences, and technical forums, demonstrating our product capabilities and staying current with industry trends and best practices  Feedback & Development: Gather and communicate client feedback to the product development team, helping to influence product enhancements and ensuring our solutions meet market demands.  Duties And Responsibilities  Manage Pre-Sales Engagements: Oversee multiple customer opportunities and related projects, prioritizing work and proactively escalating risks in consultation with the manager and sales teams  Single Point of Contact: Serve as the main technical contact for customers during the pre-sales process, engaging subject matter experts (SMEs) as needed for complex discussions or architecture reviews  Discovery & Documentation: Participate in discovery calls, accurately document customer requirements, and create technical Statements of Work (SOWs) for proposed solutions  Product Gap Analysis: Identify product gaps, create internal cases, and collaborate with the product team on feature requests and prioritization  Escalation Support: Provide technical support during customer escalations and collaborate with global internal teams during non-working hours if needed  Content Development: Develop technical collateral, including blog posts, training materials, and demos, to support internal and external enablement efforts  Continuous Improvement: Regularly provide feedback to enhance the pre-sales engineering process and improve product and technical documentation  Requirements  Education  : Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant experience.  Experience  : 7+ years in media & entertainment technologies, with 5+ years in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or broadcast engineering.  MUST have Technical Skills  :  Subject matter expertise in broadcast automation, playout, live production, graphics, and distribution workflows  Strong understanding of streaming media technologies and ad monetization  Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., AWS, GCP) and tools such as Linux, automation tools (e.g., Pulumi, Terraform, Cloud Formation, Ansible), scripting languages (e.g., Ruby, Python), workflows (e.g., Argo CI/CD, Git Ops), or containerized services (e.g., Kubernetes) is desirable  Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with sales and software engineering tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence  Language Skills: Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory; proficiency in Spanish is a plus  Communication Skills: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely in written and verbal form, including technical instructions and product descriptions  Problem-Solving & Time Management: Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving client challenges. Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, with excellent multitasking and time management skills  Additional Requirements  Must have worked with a broadcast vendor or a customer in broadcast engineering  Knowledge of broadcast operations is highly desirable  Professional certifications in public cloud technologies are a plus  No visa sponsorship or moving allowance is available  Why Join Amagi? Innovative Environment: Be part of Amagi's story at the forefront of cloud-based broadcast and streaming technology innovation  Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement in a rapidly growing industry  Collaborative Culture: Work with a passionate team dedicated to delivering success for our clients and driving innovation in the media technology space

Além de especificar soluções, atuará como elo entre usuários e equipe técnica, conduzindo negociações de prioridades, validando entregas e apoiando os usuários nos primeiros dias de utilização do sistema.  Responsabilidades:  Realizar imersão com os usuários para entender dores e necessidades reais.  Levantar e documentar requisitos em histórias de usuário e/ou especificações funcionais.  Traduzir demandas de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis para o time de desenvolvimento.  Atuar como ponte entre usuários e equipe técnica, esclarecendo dúvidas e negociando prazos, escopo e prioridades.  Validar se o que foi entregue atende ao combinado com os usuários.  Apoiar os usuários em testes de aceitação, homologação e no uso da solução nos primeiros dias após implantação.  Coordenar e monitorar a implementação em produção, garantindo suporte na produção assistida.  Identificar oportunidades de melhoria em sistemas e processos, propondo soluções inovadoras.  Requisitos Técnicos:  Experiência com análise e levantamento de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.  Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).  Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de backlog/projetos (Azure Dev Ops, Project, Jira, Trello, etc.).  Habilidade em testes funcionais e validação de entregas.  Conhecimentos básicos em bancos de dados, APIs e arquitetura de sistemas.  Habilidades Comportamentais:  Boa comunicação, empatia e capacidade de traduzir linguagem técnica para o negócio.  Habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas.  Proatividade, organização e atenção aos detalhes.  Perfil consultivo e colaborativo, atuando como facilitador entre áreas.  Diferenciais:  Experiência em apoiar usuários em processos de mudança (treinamentos, primeiros dias de uso).  Experiência como Product Owner em produtos digitais ou áreas de serviços.  Conhecimentos em UX/UI ou práticas Dev Ops.  Vivência em múltiplos projetos simultâneos, com início e fim definidos.  Informações adicionais:  Contratação CLT  Atuação HÍ BRIDA no Rio de Janeiro/RJ (região da Glória)

description: Principais Atividades:  Realizar a análise, organização e priorização das demandas da área.  Acompanhar e monitorar a equipe por meio de reuniões de status e alinhamento.  Conduzir e apoiar a implementação de projetos e processos estratégicos.  Atuar como ponto focal do sistema Zeev, promovendo melhorias e compartilhando experiências. Liderar iniciativas de mapeamento, análise e otimização de processos, propondo soluções que  aumentem a eficiência e reduzam custos.  Promover a cultura de melhoria contínua, inovação e gestão de mudanças.  Apoiar a disseminação e aplicação de metodologias de gestão de projetos e processos.  Garantir a conformidade dos processos com normas internas, políticas corporativas e requisitos regulatórios.  Elaborar e conduzir apresentações gerenciais para suporte à tomada de decisão. Vivência com coordenação ou acompanhamento de equipes.  Atuação em projetos de implementação de sistemas.  Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de processos.  Experiência em elaboração/revisão de POPS, políticas e fluxos.  Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e de gestão de projetos. title: Vendedor
description: A Sparta Engenharia é especializada em soluções completas de  Segurança Contra Incêndio e Pânico . Atuamos na elaboração de projetos técnicos, execução de obras e renovação de certificações, sempre alinhados às normas e exigências do Corpo de Bombeiros do Estado do Rio de Janeiro. Nosso compromisso é oferecer serviços de excelência, com foco na proteção de vidas e patrimônios, combinando conhecimento técnico, inovação e atendimento personalizado.  Vaga: Vendedor(a) Interno(a) – Sparta Engenharia de Incêndio  Estamos em busca de um(a) Vendedor(a) Interno(a) para integrar o nosso time comercial na  Sparta Engenharia . Se você é proativo(a), organizado(a) e possui facilidade no relacionamento com clientes, essa vaga pode ser para você!  Local de trabalho:  Presencial - Campo Grande - Rio de Janeiro/RJ   Jornada de trabalho:  Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h00 às 17h00.   Principais responsabilidades:  Elaborar orçamentos de obras e propostas comerciais de materiais utilizando sistema ERP;  Atualizar e alimentar planilhas de CRM no Excel e gerenciar processos internos via Notion;  Realizar atendimento a clientes por Whats App, telefone e reuniões presenciais;  Acompanhar o funil de vendas e contribuir com estratégias de relacionamento com clientes;  Auxiliar na organização de dados e informações para tomada de decisão da área comercial.   Requisitos obrigatórios:  Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos, dashboards);  Pacote Office intermediário (Word, Power Point, Outlook);  Experiência com CRM (planilhas) e ferramentas de gestão de processos (preferencialmente Notion);  Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;  Proatividade, organização e foco em resultados.   Diferenciais:  Experiência prévia na área de vendas B2 B;  Vivência com vendas técnicas ou projetos de engenharia;  Habilidade para lidar com múltiplos atendimentos simultâneos via Whats App e telefone.   Remuneração e benefícios:  Salário fixo:  R$ 1.700,00 ;  Comissão: 1,5% sobre todas as vendas  ;  Benefícios:  Vale-transporte (2 passagens/dia) +  Vale-almoço (R$ 27,00/dia) + Plano de Saúde + Plano Dental

title: Supervisor de manutenção offshore
description: A Brunel está em busca de um Supervisor de Manutenção para atuar no Brasil em projeto offshore de grande porte.  O profissional será responsável por todas as atividades de manutenção sob o escopo da empresa, assegurando a integridade dos equipamentos, a segurança das operações e a conformidade com a legislação brasileira (NR10). A posição supervisiona mecânicos, eletricistas, técnicos de instrumentação e motormen, garantindo a confiabilidade operacional da sonda e o cumprimento dos padrões de engenharia e HSE.  Responsabilidades  Supervisionar a equipe de manutenção e garantir que todos os trabalhos sejam executados de forma segura e conforme regulamentos internos e legais.  Planejar manutenções preventivas e corretivas junto ao Toolpusher, prevenindo falhas de equipamentos.  Gerenciar estoque e controle de sobressalentes críticos (BOP e equipamentos de controle de poço).  Garantir conformidade dos equipamentos e retirar de serviço qualquer item inseguro.  Controlar documentação de manutenção, relatórios e job cards.  Apoiar calibração e certificação de instrumentos e medidores.  Interagir com engenheiros onshore, certificadoras, representantes do cliente e terceiros, assegurando conformidade e segurança.  Recomendar melhorias e modificações para aumentar a performance da sonda e atender exigências regulatórias.  Participar de auditorias, inspeções e reuniões de segurança.  Qualificações  Ensino Médio completo.  Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em manutenção (elétrica, instrumentação ou mecânica).  Mínimo de 8 anos de experiência em óleo e gás.  Certificações obrigatórias: CBSP e HUET.  Experiência prévia em serviços de perfuração.  Inglês fluente, boa comunicação e liderança.

title: Revenue monitoring professional - consultor(a) sênior (pricing)
description: Descrição do perfil  Responsável por analisar e interpretar grandes conjuntos de dados, encontrando tendências e métricas que possam ajudar a empresa a tomar decisões mais precisas e obter melhores resultados.  Principais atividades  Monitorar, entender e compartilhar informações e dados referentes a saúde dos negócios principalmente no que tange a receita realizando análises quantitativas e qualitativas para monitorá-la;  Elaborar análises com o intuito de previsão do andamento da receita (e possíveis distorções/problemas), qualificação e monitoramento de inventário, vendas diretas e desempenho programático;  Analisar o desempenho da receita em relação as metas ou referências anteriores e fornecer ações corretivas;  Atuar de maneira funcional com várias áreas para entender as problemáticas atuais e enriquecer os relatórios com insights qualitativos.  Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação  Conhecimento em Big Data e Data Analytics;  Conhecimento em Ferramentas de análise e exploração de dados (SAS, Data Studio, Knime, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, etc.);  Conhecimento em Ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik etc);  Experiência em Avaliação Econômica de projetos;  Experiência na área de planejamento (Comercial, Receita e Financeiro);  Experiencia em análise e estruturação de dados;  Experiência em montar apresentações executivas em Power Point;  Obrigatório Superior completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Economia, Engenharias e afins.

title: Project accountant
description: Role Purpose  The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.  ⸻ Core Responsibilities  •  Financial Control & Compliance  • Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.  • Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.  • Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.  •  Reporting & Deliverables  • Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including  cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .  • Calculate and monitor  Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.  • Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.  • Prepare and monitor  hedge calculations  , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.  • Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.  •  Collaboration & Insights  • Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.  • Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including  engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .  • Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.  • Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.  •  Business Development & Bids  • Support the  analysis of new bids and tenders  , with particular focus on  cash flow projections  and financial feasibility.  • Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.  ⸻ Key Qualifications  •  Experience:  Minimum of 5 years  preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.  •  Education:  Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.  •  Technical Skills:  • Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.  • Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments. •  Languages:  Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese. •  Soft Skills:  • Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.  • Ability to work independently with  ownership of deliverables  and accountability for report quality.  • Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Coordenador de operações
description: Procurando um desafio? Seja em terra ou no mar, você encontra esse desafio na Edison Chouest  Offshore . Somos uma família de empresas voltadas para resultados e apaixonadas pela excelência. Estamos orgulhosos do mosaico de pessoas que nos torna o fornecedor líder mundial de serviços marítimos.  A Bram  Offshore  Transportes Marítimos é uma empresa do Grupo Edison Chouest  Offshore  e especializada no transporte marítimo de apoio à indústria de petróleo e gás no Brasil. Desde a chegada da primeira embarcação do Grupo Chouest, em 1991, a frota em operação no Brasil vem aumentando, já contando com mais de 70  embarcações  altamente especializadas, de última geração.  Quer se juntar a nós e fazer parte do time de  Operações ? Pré-requisitos:  Ensino  Superior Completo em  Ciências Náuticas, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;  Experiência com Gestão Pessoas e Operações na área Naval;  Disponibilidade para viagens;  Inglês Intermediário.  Responsabilidades:  Garantir que as embarcações coloquem em prática a missão, visão, valores da empresa e as estratégias operacionais definidas;  Garantir que as embarcações sejam tripuladas de acordo com a Administração e os regulamentos da bandeira;  Garantir que as operações sejam realizadas com todos os procedimentos de QSMS da empresa;  Desenhar procedimentos operacionais e seguir políticas estabelecidas;  Reforçar as premissas operacionais para as áreas de suporte, para que elas possam garantir as necessidades estabelecidas pelas embarcações;  Acompanhar e monitorar a qualidade e prazo dos serviços das áreas de suporte, apresentando para o seu superior, seus principais desafios;  Acompanhar as operações e a manutenção das embarcações diariamente;  Acompanhar os tripulantes e interagir com os clientes;  Planejar e acompanhar as trocas de turma;  Acompanhar e monitorar auditorias e inspeções;  Apoiar as práticas e procedimentos do Manual do Sistema de Gestão;  Supervisionar e avaliar os tripulantes das embarcações.  Benefícios BRAM  Offshore  : · Plano de saúde e odontológico, extensivo aos dependentes; · Vale Alimentação/Refeição; · Vale transporte; ·  Plataforma  de cursos online para todos os colaboradores; ·  Plataforma  para apoiar no cuidado da saúde mental; · Previdência Privada; · Benefício de Academias e  Plataforma  de incentivo a rotina saudável.

title: Analista de planejamento jr - licenciamento - corporativo rj
description: Fundada em 1977, a Rede D’Or é a maior rede privada de cuidados integrados do Brasil com presença em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Distrito Federal, Pernambuco, Maranhão, Sergipe, Pará, Paraíba, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso do Sul, Ceará, Bahia, Alagoas. title: Principal installation analysis engineer 25003289
description: Job Overview:  The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex Installation Analysis-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Installation Analysis Engineer may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in Installation Analysis. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in Installation Analysis as well as broad knowledge of the Installation Analysis discipline within the Engineering function.  Key Tasks and Responsibilities:  Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed analyses and design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards  Apply in-depth skills and broad knowledge of the business to address complex problems and nonstandard situations  Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and - procedures  Manage own time to meet objectives and (as Lead Engineer) forecast and plan resource requirements  Communicate and explain difficult concepts and persuade others to adopt a point of view  When acting as Lead Engineer, in addition:  Direct an Engineering team as a Lead Engineer  Lead the Discipline engineering design of the assigned work area and complete it within the planned schedule and budget, in accordance with standards, MDR, and project-specific procedures and to a high professional standard  Plan, organize, and direct all aspects of Discipline execution on the assigned project including scope, deliverables, schedule, and all manpower resources - agree allocations with the Discipline Manager  Ensure interfaces and deliverables are clearly identified  Maintain responsibility for progress and productivity, identifying any required corrective action  Act as project representative for Discipline during meetings with the Project Team, Customer discipline lead, and relevant agencies such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.  Become fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address issues, interpreting contractual requirements as they relate to engineering execution  Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for variation orders  Interface with all disciplines to develop clash-free designs  Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings  Maintain close coordination with other engineering disciplines, Planning, fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required  Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to Discipline Lead Engineer and Discipline Manager  Prepare estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and manhour estimates, identifying software requirements and any other project-specific requirements  Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred Mc Dermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements  Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications  Participate in finalizing deliverable lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity  Review project schedule and fabrication schedule in relation to construction sequence, milestones, and engineering scope  Attend project kickoff and review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required  Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Installation Support Engineering  Prepare, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve design reports and procedures  Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables  Assist procurement personnel in procuring discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with Customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing, reviewing, and (as Lead Engineer) approving requisitions, evaluating technical quotations, and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer  Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information  Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as necessary  Review and (as Lead Engineer) approve design verification through single-discipline check /inter-discipline check (IDC) Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements  Keep the Discipline Manager and Project Management Team apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary and manpower related  Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity  Check final subcontractor and vendor data manuals to ensure that all requested data has been received and approved  Present issues and problems to Customers in a timely manner and assist the Lead Engineer in negotiating resolution in accordance with project and company requirements  Perform (as required) Technical Quality Audit reviews in accordance with MDR Global Procedures  Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval  Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system  Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval  Supervise and guide assigned engineers and coordinate with Lead Designers for Discipline engineering and design deliverables  Responsible for the engineering integrity of the assigned work area  Monitor costs of own work processes  Assist in the maintenance of departmental technical guidelines and standard calculation notes  Participate in development and maintenance of Global Procedures, Software, and Standards  May participate in standards development committees or task groups such as API  Develop communication and presentation skills (e.g., write technical papers, participate in conferences and/or seminars, present design solutions, and/or present topics at ‘lunch and learn’; etc.) Identify and provide training to staff in specific techniques and proprietary software  Provide information on employee performance to the Discipline Manager  Assist the Discipline manager in interviewing job applicants  Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Pipeline Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids):  Submarine pipelines  Risers  Spools  PLETS and manifolds  Cables  Perform, review, and (as Lead Engineer) approve Structural Installation engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation (including installation aids) of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications  When acting as Lead engineer, in addition:  Act as project-based discipline point of contact in communications and meetings with customer counterparts  Ensure substantive communications are documented  Prepare bids and projects discipline engineering budget and execution plans  Identify project staff needs based on knowledge of individual engineer’s skill sets and provide requests to the discipline manager  Plan, organize, and assign tasks, responsibilities, and manhour budgets to the discipline team, and verify tasks are completed within budgets  Plan discipline deliverable schedule/register compliant with the overall execution plan  Prepare work forecasts identifying change management plans, corrective action, and real-time schedule  Provide discipline inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity   Essential Qualifications and Education:  Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master’s is a preference)15-20 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design  Detailed knowledge of design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the theory, content, and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable Knowledgeable in project coordination and execution skills  Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

title: Product owner

title: Consultor de viagens

title: Diretor de operações
description: A Brunel está em busca de um  Diretor de Operações  (Perfuração) para integrar o time de um de seus maiores clientes no setor de Petróleo e Gás no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.  Como Diretor de Operações de Perfuração, você será responsável por supervisionar todo o planejamento e a execução de campanhas de perfuração, garantindo segurança, conformidade regulatória, eficiência operacional e alinhamento com as expectativas da empresa e clientes.  Responsabilidades:  Liderar todo o ciclo das operações de perfuração, desde o planejamento do poço e mobilização da sonda até a execução e análise pós-operação. Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de controle de custos para otimizar os orçamentos de perfuração (CAPEX/OPEX).  Supervisionar a seleção de sondas e garantir conformidade com as regras de aceitação de sondas da Petrobras e os requisitos do RASMA.  Manter rigorosa conformidade com as normas da ANP e as NRs (Normas Regulamentadoras) brasileiras relacionadas à segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional.  Coordenar a preparação técnica e a documentação para auditorias e inspeções da Petrobras.  Identificar, documentar e liderar o encerramento de itens de não conformidade (Categorias A, B e C), conforme a classificação da Petrobras.  Atuar como elo principal entre as partes interessadas internas e órgãos reguladores (ANP, Petrobras, IBAMA, etc.).  Monitorar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs), incluindo ROP, NPT e prazos de entrega de poços.  Promover uma cultura orientada para a segurança por meio de programas proativos de SMS, investigações de incidentes e gestão de riscos.  Responsabilidades de Conformidade e Regulação  Familiaridade com as regras da Petrobras para aceitação de sondas de perfuração, incluindo especificações de equipamentos, protocolos de inspeção e requisitos de documentação.  Capacidade de comunicar e resolver não conformidades classificadas como Categoria A, B e C pela Petrobras, atuando diretamente com equipes de inspeção e auditoria.  Conhecimento aprofundado das regulamentações da ANP que afetam operações de perfuração, relatórios, conteúdo local e licenciamento operacional.  Compreensão dos protocolos RASMA (Rig Acceptance Safety and Maintenance Assessment) da Petrobras, incluindo revisão periódica e mitigação de riscos.  Conhecimento abrangente das NRs relacionadas ao setor de óleo e gás, incluindo NR-10 (Segurança em Eletricidade), NR-12 (Máquinas), NR-13 (Vasos de Pressão), NR-20 (Inflamáveis) e NR-37 (Operações Offshore).  Requisitos:  Graduação em Engenharia de Petróleo, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.  Mínimo de 10 a 15 anos de experiência em operações de perfuração, incluindo funções de liderança.  Experiência comprovada em projetos e auditorias operados pela Petrobras.  Certificações em controle de poços (IWCF/IADC), HSE e conformidade regulatória.  Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de resolução de problemas, com capacidade de engajar partes interessadas técnicas e não técnicas.  Inglês Fluente

Além disso, deve estar disposto a viajar frequentemente e atuar em plataformas de petróleo, demonstrando flexibilidade e adaptabilidade. Para este cargo, você precisará:  Formação em Técnico de Automação ou instrumentação  Experiência mínima de 2 anos atuando em atividade de automação em área industrial, sendo no mínimo 1 desses anos atuando em unidades de produção de óleo e gás natural ou plantas de processamento de óleo e gás natural.  Ingles intermediário  Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:  Curso de salvatagem CBSP + T-Huet  Conhecimento do CLP Emerson (antigo GE Fanuc) Conhecimento em Sistema SCADA   Nossa oferta para você:  Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos funcionários e sabemos que, para dar o melhor de si, você deve ter benefícios flexíveis e competitivos para atender às necessidades físicas, mentais, financeiras e sociais, suas e de sua família. Para isso, oferecemos seguro de vida em grupo, assistência médica e odontológica, vale alimentação, PLR anual. Nossos funcionários também podem contar com o apoio de cooperativa de crédito e o programa de apoio ao empregado Emerson Care. Somos empresa cidadã o que nos permite oferecer licença parental remunerada (materna e paterna) diferenciada. Além disso, preocupados com o seu futuro, também oferecemos Plano de Previdência Privada.  Na Emerson, temos o compromisso de incentivar uma cultura onde cada funcionário seja valorizado e respeitado por suas experiências e perspectivas excepcionais. Acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho diversificado e inclusivo contribui para a rica troca de ideias e diversidade de pensamentos, que incentivam a inovação e trazem as melhores soluções aos nossos clientes.  Essa filosofia é fundamental para viver os valores da nossa empresa e a nossa responsabilidade de deixar o mundo num lugar melhor. Saiba mais sobre nossa  e sobre  na Emerson.  Nossos programas e iniciativas de treinamento concentram-se no desenvolvimento de ponta a ponta, desde a integração até a liderança sênior. Oferecemos uma gama de oportunidades de desenvolvimento, incluindo treinamento presencial e virtual, além de programas de mentoria.  Same Posting Description for Internal and External Candidates

Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.  Somos uma empresa PLURAL! Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.  Nosso propósito e valores  Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos:  Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.  Na MAG temos o forte propósito de  oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.  Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.  Quer fazer parte dessa história? Conheça a nossa oportunidade.  Quais serão seus desafios: • Liderar auditorias não regulatórias relacionadas à áreas específicas do mercado de seguros. Também liderar auditorias relacionadas à áreas estratégicas da Companhia que possua conhecimento no assunto a ser objetivo de auditoria com acompanhamento pontual do gestor, de acordo com a metodologia aplicável, considerando os aspectos da operação local e da legislação vigente, desde a fase de planejamento até a emissão do relatório; • Revisar as auditorias executadas por outros membros da equipe e executar qualquer auditoria liderada por outro profissional da equipe; • Manter as partes interessadas atualizadas sobre o projeto de auditoria com apoio limitado do gestor; • Discutir as deficiências identificadas nos projetos de auditoria com o 1º nível de gestão da área objeto da auditoria com apoio do gestor; • Acompanhar projetos corporativos atualizando o gestor periodicamente; • Executar as auditorias especiais ou outras demandas extras atualizando o gestor periodicamente; • Dominar a metodologia da auditoria e dar suporte aos profissionais de menor senioridade; • Sugerir formas de melhorar a execução dos projetos de auditoria; • Realizar benchmarking com outras áreas/empresas e contribuir com projetos da Área.  O que esperamos de você:  Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Atuária, Estatística ou Engenharias;  Sólida vivência na área de auditoria interna, riscos ou controles internos;  Conhecimento em ferramentas de Data Analytics, ACL, Power BI e sistemas de formalização dos trabalhos de auditoria;  Conhecimento avançado de inglês;  Perfil antenado as boas práticas de mercado, proativo, flexível e com excelente relacionamento interpessoal;  Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida, presencialmente de 4 a 8 vezes por mês no Centro do Rio de Janeiro. Caso seja colaborador(a) da MAG e resida fora do Rio, a atuação deverá ocorrer em unidade da MAG mais próxima à residência, na mesma frequência.   Será um diferencial se você tiver:  Certificação ISO31000 e/ou CIA;  Cursos na área de auditoria, riscos e/ou controles internos;  O que temos de bom:  Salário compatível com o mercado  Vale-transporte  Vale refeição (sem desconto em folha e mantido durante as férias) Vale alimentação (sem desconto em folha, mantido durante as férias e saldo extra no mês de Dezembro) Plano de saúde  Plano odontológico  Auxílio Creche  Previdência Privada  Assistência funeral (extensivo a dependentes e aos pais) PPR  Seguro de vida  Gympass  Assistência psicológica, financeira e jurídica para você e seus dependentes  Atendimento médico e nutricional  Happy Day - uma folga no mês do aniversário  Universidade corporativa  Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas
